web.title: Chennai Metro Rail Phase 2 — corridors, stations and progress
web.snippet: Phase 2 of Chennai Metro adds three corridors — Madhavaram to SIPCOT, Poonamallee to Light House, and Madhavaram to Sholinganallur — roughly 116 km of new line and more than 120 stations, making it one of the largest metro expansions in India.

web.title: Chennai Metro Rail Limited — official site
web.snippet: Official information from CMRL: timetables, fares, station facilities, travel cards, parking, and project updates for Phase 1 and the Phase 2 corridors under construction.

web.title: Chennai — capital of Tamil Nadu
web.snippet: Chennai, formerly Madras, is the capital of Tamil Nadu and one of India's largest cities. It is known for its automobile industry, IT corridor along OMR, Marina Beach, Carnatic music season and classical Bharatanatyam.

web.title: Marina Beach, Chennai
web.snippet: Marina Beach is a natural urban beach along the Bay of Bengal in Chennai, running about 6 km from Fort St. George to Foreshore Estate. It is one of the longest urban beaches in the world.

web.title: Kanchipuram silk saree — history and weaving
web.snippet: Kanchipuram silk sarees are woven from pure mulberry silk in Kanchipuram, Tamil Nadu. They are known for heavy zari borders, contrasting pallus and temple motifs, and hold a Geographical Indication tag.
tags: how to identify pure kanchipuram silk

web.title: Kanchipuram — the city of a thousand temples
web.snippet: Kanchipuram, about 70 km from Chennai, is famous for Ekambareswarar, Kailasanathar and Varadharaja Perumal temples, and for its hand-woven silk industry.

web.title: Mahabalipuram — Group of Monuments (UNESCO)
web.snippet: The Group of Monuments at Mahabalipuram, carved by the Pallava kings in the 7th and 8th centuries, includes the Shore Temple, the rathas, and the open-air rock relief known as Arjuna's Penance.

web.title: Spring Boot — reference documentation
web.snippet: Spring Boot makes it easy to create stand-alone, production-grade Spring applications that you can just run. It takes an opinionated view of the Spring platform so you can get started with minimum configuration.

web.title: Spring Boot 3.3 release notes
web.snippet: Spring Boot 3.3 adds support for Class Data Sharing, improved observability, virtual thread support in more places, Bitnami container image support for service connections, and many dependency upgrades.

web.title: FastAPI — modern, fast web framework for building APIs with Python
web.snippet: FastAPI is a high-performance web framework for building APIs with Python based on standard type hints. It gives automatic interactive docs, request validation with Pydantic, and async support out of the box.

web.title: FastAPI tutorial — first steps
web.snippet: Create a FastAPI app in a single file, declare a path operation with a decorator, and run it with uvicorn. Open /docs to get automatic Swagger UI for every endpoint you write.

web.title: Uvicorn — an ASGI web server for Python
web.snippet: Uvicorn is a lightning-fast ASGI server implementation using uvloop and httptools. It is the usual way to run FastAPI and Starlette applications in development and production.

web.title: Flask — a lightweight WSGI web application framework
web.snippet: Flask is a lightweight Python web framework designed to make getting started quick and easy, with the ability to scale up to complex applications.

web.title: Django — the web framework for perfectionists with deadlines
web.snippet: Django is a high-level Python web framework that encourages rapid development and clean, pragmatic design. It ships with an ORM, admin site, authentication and forms.

web.title: Python — official website
web.snippet: Python is a programming language that lets you work quickly and integrate systems more effectively. Download the latest release, read the docs, and find tutorials for beginners.

web.title: venv — creation of virtual environments (Python docs)
web.snippet: The venv module creates lightweight virtual environments, each with its own independent set of Python packages installed in its site directories. Run python -m venv .venv, then activate it.

web.title: React — the library for web and native user interfaces
web.snippet: React lets you build user interfaces out of individual pieces called components written in JavaScript. Learn React with interactive tutorials, and read the API reference for hooks like useState and useEffect.

web.title: Built-in React Hooks — useState, useEffect, useRef
web.snippet: Hooks let you use different React features from your components. State hooks remember information, Effect hooks connect to external systems, and Ref hooks hold values that don't trigger re-renders.

web.title: Vite — next generation frontend tooling
web.snippet: Vite is a blazing fast frontend build tool with instant server start, lightning-fast hot module replacement, and optimized production builds powered by Rollup.

web.title: JavaScript — MDN Web Docs
web.snippet: JavaScript is a lightweight, interpreted, just-in-time compiled language with first-class functions. MDN covers the language guide, reference for every built-in object, and browser APIs.

web.title: Using the Fetch API — MDN
web.snippet: The Fetch API provides a JavaScript interface for making HTTP requests and processing responses. Pass an AbortController signal to cancel an in-flight request.

web.title: TypeScript — JavaScript with syntax for types
web.snippet: TypeScript is a strongly typed programming language that builds on JavaScript, giving you better tooling at any scale.

web.title: Node.js — run JavaScript everywhere
web.snippet: Node.js is a free, open-source, cross-platform JavaScript runtime environment that lets developers create servers, web apps, command line tools and scripts.

web.title: Tailwind CSS — rapidly build modern websites
web.snippet: Tailwind CSS is a utility-first CSS framework packed with classes like flex, pt-4, text-center and rotate-90 that can be composed to build any design, directly in your markup.

web.title: CSS Grid Layout — MDN
web.snippet: CSS grid layout introduces a two-dimensional grid system to CSS. Grids can be used to lay out major page areas or small user interface elements.

web.title: Docker — develop faster, run anywhere
web.snippet: Docker helps developers build, share, run and verify applications anywhere, without tedious environment configuration. Package an app and its dependencies into a portable container image.

web.title: Dockerfile reference
web.snippet: A Dockerfile is a text document that contains all the commands a user could call to assemble an image. Multi-stage builds let you keep build tools out of the final image.

web.title: Kubernetes — production-grade container orchestration
web.snippet: Kubernetes is an open-source system for automating deployment, scaling, and management of containerized applications.

web.title: PostgreSQL — the world's most advanced open source database
web.snippet: PostgreSQL is a powerful, open source object-relational database system with over 35 years of active development and a strong reputation for reliability, feature robustness, and performance.

web.title: SQLite — small, fast, self-contained SQL database engine
web.snippet: SQLite is a C-language library that implements a small, fast, self-contained, high-reliability, full-featured SQL database engine. It is the most used database engine in the world.

web.title: Redis — the real-time data platform
web.snippet: Redis is an in-memory data store used as a database, cache, message broker and streaming engine. SET with NX and PX gives an atomic expiring lock.

web.title: Git — distributed version control
web.snippet: Git is a free and open source distributed version control system designed to handle everything from small to very large projects with speed and efficiency.

web.title: GitHub — where the world builds software
web.snippet: GitHub is a platform for hosting code, reviewing pull requests, running CI with Actions, and collaborating on open-source and private projects.

web.title: Linux — the Linux Kernel Archives
web.snippet: The Linux kernel is a free and open-source Unix-like operating system kernel. Browse stable releases, mainline, and long-term support kernels.

web.title: Rust — a language empowering everyone to build reliable software
web.snippet: Rust is blazingly fast and memory-efficient, with no runtime or garbage collector. Its ownership model guarantees memory-safety and thread-safety at compile time.

web.title: The Go programming language
web.snippet: Go is an open source programming language that makes it simple to build secure, scalable systems, with goroutines and channels for concurrency built into the language.

web.title: Java — Oracle / OpenJDK
web.snippet: OpenJDK is the open-source reference implementation of the Java Platform, Standard Edition. Java 21 is a long-term support release with virtual threads and record patterns.

web.title: Okapi BM25 — ranking function used by search engines
web.snippet: BM25 is a bag-of-words ranking function that scores documents by query-term frequency, inverse document frequency and document length. It is the default scoring in Lucene and Elasticsearch.

web.title: Elasticsearch — distributed search and analytics engine
web.snippet: Elasticsearch is a distributed, RESTful search and analytics engine built on Apache Lucene, used for full-text search, logging and observability.

web.title: Machine learning — Wikipedia
web.snippet: Machine learning is a field of study in artificial intelligence concerned with statistical algorithms that learn from data and generalise to unseen data, performing tasks without explicit instructions.

web.title: Large language model — Wikipedia
web.snippet: A large language model is a language model trained with self-supervised learning on vast amounts of text, designed for natural language processing tasks such as generation, summarisation and question answering.

web.title: Indian Premier League — official site
web.snippet: The IPL is a professional Twenty20 cricket league in India contested by ten city-based franchises. Find fixtures, results, points table and team squads.

web.title: Chennai Super Kings — Wikipedia
web.snippet: Chennai Super Kings is a franchise cricket team based in Chennai that plays in the IPL. Its home ground is the M. A. Chidambaram Stadium in Chepauk.

web.title: ISRO — Indian Space Research Organisation
web.snippet: ISRO is India's national space agency. Explore missions including Chandrayaan-3, which landed near the lunar south pole in 2023, and Aditya-L1, India's first solar observatory.

web.title: Chandrayaan-3 — Wikipedia
web.snippet: Chandrayaan-3 is the third mission in ISRO's lunar exploration programme. Its Vikram lander touched down near the Moon's south pole on 23 August 2023.

web.title: South Indian filter coffee — Wikipedia
web.snippet: Filter coffee is a coffee drink made by mixing frothed and boiled milk with the infusion obtained by percolating finely ground coffee powder in a traditional metal filter.

web.title: Web accessibility — MDN
web.snippet: Accessibility is the practice of making websites usable by as many people as possible. Learn semantic HTML, ARIA, keyboard focus and colour contrast.

web.title: REST API design — best practices
web.snippet: REST is a set of architectural constraints for building web APIs: resources identified by URLs, standard HTTP methods, stateless requests and meaningful status codes.

web.title: HTTP response status codes — MDN
web.snippet: HTTP response status codes indicate whether a request completed: informational (100–199), success (200–299), redirection (300–399), client errors (400–499) and server errors (500–599).

questions.question: How many stations are in Chennai Metro Phase 2?
questions.snippet: Phase 2 plans more than 120 stations across its three corridors, a mix of elevated and underground.

questions.question: When will Chennai Metro Phase 2 open?
questions.snippet: Sections are opening in stages; the Poonamallee–Porur stretch of Corridor 4 is among the first to be completed.

questions.question: What is Chennai famous for?
questions.snippet: Marina Beach, Carnatic music, temples, filter coffee, the automobile industry and a large IT corridor.

questions.question: How do I identify a pure Kanchipuram silk saree?
questions.snippet: Look for the GI tag and silk mark, a separately woven border joined to the body, and real zari that shows red silk under the gold when scratched.

questions.question: Is FastAPI faster than Flask?
questions.snippet: FastAPI runs on ASGI with async support and is generally faster than Flask under concurrent I/O-bound load.

questions.question: What is FastAPI used for?
questions.snippet: Building HTTP APIs in Python — backends for web and mobile apps, ML model serving, and internal services.

questions.question: What are React hooks?
questions.snippet: Hooks are functions like useState and useEffect that let function components use state and other React features.

questions.question: What is the difference between useEffect and useLayoutEffect?
questions.snippet: useLayoutEffect fires synchronously after DOM mutations but before paint; useEffect runs after paint.

questions.question: Is Spring Boot still worth learning?
questions.snippet: Spring Boot remains one of the most widely used Java backend frameworks in enterprise software.

questions.question: What is the difference between Docker and Kubernetes?
questions.snippet: Docker builds and runs containers; Kubernetes orchestrates many containers across a cluster of machines.

questions.question: When should I use SQLite instead of PostgreSQL?
questions.snippet: SQLite suits single-machine apps, prototypes and embedded use; PostgreSQL suits many concurrent writers and networked access.

questions.question: How does a search engine rank results?
questions.snippet: Classic engines score documents with functions like BM25, combining term frequency, rarity and document length.

questions.question: How do I create a virtual environment in Python?
questions.snippet: Run python -m venv .venv, then activate it with .venv\Scripts\activate on Windows or source .venv/bin/activate on macOS and Linux.

questions.question: Where did Chandrayaan-3 land?
questions.snippet: The Vikram lander touched down near the lunar south pole, at a site later named Shiv Shakti Point.

questions.question: Which is the home ground of Chennai Super Kings?
questions.snippet: M. A. Chidambaram Stadium, Chepauk, Chennai.
